articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu accuses Benny Gantz, Gadi Eisenkot of backing Hamas's terms in war cabinet
articles.summary: Netanyahu criticized opposition leaders Gantz and Eisenkot for positions he claimed would have accepted Hamas's terms, and defended the government's military strategy in Gaza and Lebanon.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu, Katz: IDF to remain in Lebanon until Hezbollah disarmament
articles.summary: Netanyahu affirmed that IDF forces will remain in Lebanon's security zones until Hezbollah is fully disarmed and northern Israel's security is guaranteed.

articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu announced his intention to build an election campaign around ending the political boycott against him and forming a broad national unity coalition government.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu backs ending US military aid to build Israel armaments independence
articles.summary: Netanyahu expressed support for phasing out American military assistance to Israel and transitioning to a partnership based on mutual defense projects and shared strategic interests.
